post.description:
One chat turn with Mr OneHook: a product question, or (with `matchId`) help with one connection.

Codes: 400 `INVALID_CONTEXTUAL_CHAT_REQUEST`; 401 `AUTH_REQUIRED`, `INVALID_ACCESS_TOKEN`; 402
`MESSAGE_LIMIT_REACHED` (free tier: 10 messages per UTC day); 403 `CHAT_SESSION_NOT_INCLUDED_IN_TIER`,
`MESSAGE_CONTEXT_NOT_ALLOWED`; 404 `MATCH_NOT_AVAILABLE`, `CHAT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND`,
`ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `CHAT_SESSION_LIMIT_REACHED`; 429 `RATE_LIMITED`, `AI_RATE_LIMITED`; 503
`CONTEXT_NOT_CONFIGURED`, `CHAT_SESSION_STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED`, `CHAT_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE`,
`CONTEXT_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
A UUID makes the turn idempotent: it becomes the `requestId`, and a repeated turn is stored once.
Anything else is ignored and a new id is minted.

schema.description:
A UUID makes the turn idempotent: it becomes the `requestId`, and a repeated turn is stored once.
Anything else is ignored and a new id is minted.

get.description:
The member's saved chat sessions, newest first (expired ones are left out).
503 `CHAT_SESSION_STORAGE_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE` when the store cannot be read.

delete.description: Deletes a saved session. Idempotent: an unknown UUID is also 204.

get.description:
One saved session with its messages (the tier's most recent ones). 404 `CHAT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND` for an
unknown id, another member's session, or a connection session whose match is no longer visible.

post.description:
The anonymous mascot chat on the public site. 10 requests per minute per client IP (429). A
non-empty `honeypot` is refused (403). Upstream model errors map to 400 (the model refused the
request), 429 (the model is rate limited) or 503 (any other model error); anything else is 500.

BadRequestErrorResponseContent.description:
Mr OneHook's error body. On member routes `error` is a stable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE code; on the public
route it is a human-readable message.

ChatSessionLimitReachedErrorResponseCont.description:
409 `CHAT_SESSION_LIMIT_REACHED`: a new saved session would exceed the tier's cap. Before the model
call it lists the sessions so the app can offer a choice; a race at save time carries neither field.

ContextDateRange.description: At least one bound; `from` is not after `to`.

requestId.description: The turn's `requestId`; send it back as `contextRequestId`.

ContextUsed.description: Which context went into the answer.

sentAt.description: ISO-8601, at most 5 minutes in the future.

ForbiddenErrorResponseContent.description:
Mr OneHook's error body. On member routes `error` is a stable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE code; on the public
route it is a human-readable message.

InternalServerErrorResponseContent.description:
Mr OneHook's error body. On member routes `error` is a stable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE code; on the public
route it is a human-readable message.

MatchSuggestionResult.description: What happened to a "find me ..." request. The prompt Mr OneHook wrote is never returned.

reasoning.description: Why Mr OneHook is suggesting these people (1 to 280 characters).

MessageLimitReachedErrorResponseContent.description: 402 `MESSAGE_LIMIT_REACHED`: the free tier's daily messages are spent.

Mood.description: Mr OneHook's mood, which drives the mascot's face.

NotFoundErrorResponseContent.description:
Mr OneHook's error body. On member routes `error` is a stable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE code; on the public
route it is a human-readable message.

PayloadTooLargeErrorResponseContent.description: 413 `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`: the JSON body is over 32 KB.

message.description: 1 to `CONTEXT_MAX_INPUT_CHARACTERS` (default 4000) characters; trimmed, must not be blank.

matchId.description: Present: a connection chat about this match (1 to 256 characters). Absent: a product chat.

contextRequestId.description: UUID of a `contextRequest` this turn answers.

needsMoreContext.description: Connection chats only: Mr OneHook needs more of the conversation; `contextRequest` says what.

remainingMessages.description: Free tier only: messages left today after this one.

messages.description: The conversation so far; the last message is the visitor's.

honeypot.description: Bot trap: must be absent or empty.

ServiceUnavailableErrorResponseContent.description:
Mr OneHook's error body. On member routes `error` is a stable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE code; on the public

SessionOptions.description: Saving the conversation needs a paid tier (403 `CHAT_SESSION_NOT_INCLUDED_IN_TIER` otherwise).

sessionId.description: Continue this saved session (UUID). Cannot be combined with `persist: false`.

replaceLeastRecent.description: At the tier's session cap, delete the least recently active session instead of answering 409.
